Both repairs are applied at RESOLUTION time in the new scripts/todo-graph/ref_resolution.py, which lint Check 7's walk AND the identity snapshot both call so they cannot drift. (1) BASENAME REPAIR -- a stored .c/.h path with no directory component that does not exist at the repo root, whose basename is unique among the tree's .c/.h files, is checked against that file (e.g. `boot_desktop.c` -> `src/kernel/main/boot_desktop.c`). It applies to `kind=file` refs as well as `kind=symbol` refs: 673 of the corpus's 1,167 stamped .c/.h FILE refs do not exist at their authored path and 629 are bare and tree-unique, so repairing only symbol refs starved the section-scope pairing of candidates (Codex adversarial, +158 occurrences once fixed). The 8 that remain -- 7 occurrences across 2 ambiguous basenames (`entropy.c`, `entropy.h`) plus 1 for an absent one (`hv_bar.h`) -- are never guessed and stay counted. (2) SECTION-SCOPE PAIRING -- a symbol ref carrying no file of its own is paired to a file when exactly ONE of the files its own TODO SECTION's stamped items author actually defines it; build.py pairs only within an ITEM, so an item whose sibling item named the file loses a pairing the section really does carry. One false positive surfaced by the new visibility was fixed at its cause rather than marked: `return <bare identifier>;` is no longer read as a stub when the identifier names a file-scope VARIABLE in the same translation unit, because that is an accessor reading state (compositor_get_test_seed at src/kernel/main/compositor.c:64), not a placeholder; `return STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED;` still fires and neither a macro nor an enum constant can satisfy the exemption. why: Check 7 can only inspect a stamped symbol it can RESOLVE; an unresolved ref yields no finding, so losing resolution is indistinguishable from passing. This number is the floor: a drop is an ERROR (rc 7). Raising it is the point -- when the resolver improves, update this file in the same commit and say what changed. This file is TRACKED state and is enforced fail-CLOSED (rc 8) when missing or malformed; STUB_LINT_ALLOW_NO_BASELINE=1 is the deliberate, reported bypass. `total` is enforced too: the floor is a RATIO, so a shrinking denominator would let refs lost from the cache read as an improved ratio (rc 7 on any move, in either direction).
